notes: Training robots are those of configs/data/*.json (go1, anymal_d, g1_29dof, quadrotor_x, G1 arms) WITHOUT h1: proposal v4 names H1 an L4 robot, but configs/data/synthetic_unitree.json, ground_contact.json and configs/rl/go1_h1_ground.json train on it. A zero-shot training config must drop the h1 sources; SplitManifest.check_training_config lists such sources.

Splits of L1-L3 come from make_heldout_split(entries, fraction=0.2, seed=0) per level (Ai et al., CoRL 2025: 20% held out); test is the held-out part. L0 and L4 are test only: L0 uses held-out episodes, and L4 is the final real-robot check.

L1 categories are MetaMorph's six (Gupta et al., ICLR 2022, Fig. 6; ranges Table 2) plus size. MetaMorph's density and gear ranges coincide with this repo's training randomization, so they are not out of distribution for synthetic-trained models; see the per-entry notes.

L1-L3 entries are generator specifications. Procedural entries (L2, L3) are model.morphology.generate_robot(family, seed, ranges) calls; each gives one robot, and more robots per entry come from more seeds (counts are not fixed here). parameter_variation entries (L1) have no generator in the tree yet: a tool must write the modified URDF.
L2/L3 values are Ai et al. Table 6 (knee joints {0,1,2,3}, foot size {1.0, 2.0}), written as model.morphology range overrides (lists of candidates).
L4 is missing LocoMuJoCo's other humanoids (proposal v4): they ship MJCF only, and this pipeline needs URDF.

Procedural training sources (model/training/procedural.py) must not generate hexapods and must restrict ranges so no L2 robot can appear (for example knee_joints [1] and foot_scale [1.0] for quadrupeds and humanoids); SplitManifest.check_training_config flags sources that can.
No entry has expert-motion sources yet, so scripts/evaluate_zero_shot.py needs per-level data configs with motions (--level-data-config).

levels_described.L1: parameter changes of training robots (MetaMorph's six categories) and size extrapolation
levels_described.L2: new topology within a training family (knee count, foot size)
